rules.coverage_text: Residential buildings constructed on or before February 1, 1995.

exemptions.quote: The rent cap does not apply to residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, or to mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.

key_values.name: cpi_fraction
key_values.text: 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index

rules.quote: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% or 80% of the 12-month CPI change. No increase is permitted if CPI is negative.
rules.title: Annual rent increase cap

rules.cite: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: Residential rentals other than housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, and similar exempt types.

exemptions.description: Housing produced in last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotels, care facilities, dormitories, shared living
exemptions.quote: The Just Cause Ordinance shall not apply to certain types of residential property, including housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.

rules.quote: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, owners may only terminate for just cause stated in written notice. No-fault terminations require 3 months relocation assistance or rent waiver for the final 3 months.
rules.title: Just cause eviction
